graph.title: Garbage Truck
notes: The instruction pictures are small and low resolution; exact stud positions (e.g. stud.R.C on the vehicle base) and which brick each plate sits on are best-guess readings of the steps.

Step assignment: 1 base + clip plate b2; 2 b3, b4; 3 b5, b6, b8; 4 b7; 5 green plates b9, b10; 6-7 box panels b11-b15 and lime round plates b16, b17; 8 black arms b18, b19; 9 seat b20, bracket b22, bar b21; 10 grille and headlights; 11 steering stand and orange cone; 12 bar into rear clips; 14 broom, shovel, brown round plates, 2 trash cans with lids; 15 four wheels with tyres.
Arms b18/b19 are modelled as a ball/pin-in-clip chain on the clip brick b3; the cone is held by b19's clip, the shovel by b19's other clip, the broom by b8's clip.

Trash cans are shown beside the truck without a clear fastening; modelled as contact with the box panel b12. The wheel-to-base joins use null base ports because the wheel-pin port names are not visible.
Tyres have no ports; each tyre is joined to its wheel with null ports.
